title: New GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Highlights Leisure Activities and Water Graphics
description: Polygon reports on new, unofficial GTA 6 gameplay footage showcasing optional leisure activities for Jason and Lucia alongside impressive water graphics.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## New Unofficial GTA 6 Footage Emerges Ahead of Netflix Reveal

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' highly anticipated open-world epic, new glimpses of the title occasionally surface across the internet. According to a recent report by Polygon, fresh, unofficial gameplay footage from *Grand Theft Auto VI* has made its way online, offering a look at some of the optional leisure activities available to protagonists Jason and Lucia, alongside some notably impressive water graphics.

### Spotlighting Optional Leisure Activities for Jason and Lucia

Rockstar Games has long been celebrated for crafting living, breathing virtual worlds filled with diverse side activities and immersive downtime options for players. According to the Polygon report, the leaked footage provides a peek into how Jason and Lucia can engage in various optional leisure activities within the game world. While these clips are entirely unofficial, they hint at the depth of side content and the freedom players might expect when exploring the fictionalized version of Vice City and its surrounding areas.

### Showcasing Impressive Water Graphics

In addition to the character activities, the footage reportedly highlights some striking water graphics. Given the coastal setting traditionally associated with Vice City, dynamic water rendering, wave physics, and lighting reflections are crucial components of the visual fidelity for *GTA 6*. The details noted in the media coverage underscore the technical ambitions behind the game's open-world environment, sparking plenty of conversation among graphics enthusiasts and the broader community.

### Editor's Take

While leaks and unofficial footage always generate immense excitement, it is important to view them with cautious optimism. These clips offer a tantalizing glimpse into Jason and Lucia's leisure activities and water rendering capabilities, but fans should ultimately wait for official updates and reveals from Rockstar Games to see the true final quality of the game.
